intro.text: A plant of Hallandren's valley jungle whose prized dyes are the foundation of Hallandren's wealth.

description.text: Though Hallandren is remote, the dyes were rare and sought after across Nalthis, making T'Telir a major port and anchoring trade between Hallandren and other kingdoms.

items.text: The wealth the Tears brought was among the causes of the Manywar.
